# CANDIDATE: VWAP_ANCHORED_RECLAIM_REJECTION_V1

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The VWAP anchored entry (reclaim/rejection) captures intraday continuation bias after the first three RTH closes are on one side of the session VWAP. This edge exists because institutional order flow tends to push price away from VWAP after establishing a directional bias, creating a short-term trend that can be harvested with tight risk management.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers when price reclaims or rejects the VWAP within proximity_dollars (e.g., $0.15) on a bar with volume at least vol_mult times the 20-bar average, body size >= body_min_cents, and lookback_bars confirmation of VWAP side. Requires ribbon agreement and minimum ribbon spread. Exit: TP1 at tp1_premium_pct of entry premium (qty fraction tp1_qty_fraction), runner to runner_target_pct, profit-lock arms at profit_lock_threshold_pct and trails by profit_lock_stop_offset_pct, catastrophe stop at premium_stop_pct.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=3 contracts; assuming average entry premium $1.00, capital per trade = $300; to risk 50% of account per trade requires $600 account; Safe account minimum $2K allows full qty; $1K paper account would realize ~30% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** Parameter sweep over VWAP anchored entry dimensions (vol_mult, proximity_dollars, lookback_bars, body_min_cents, premium_stop_pct, tp1_premium_pct, runner_target_pct, strike_offset, qty, tp1_qty_fraction, profit_lock_threshold_pct, profit_lock_stop_offset_pct, require_ribbon_agreement, ribbon_min_spread_cents). Exact combo count unknown; selecting top keeper from 5 keepers introduces selection bias and overfit risk.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no realistic OPRA bid/ask simulation on top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: failure to capture a J winner while incurring a loss on a loser day (e.g., -$260 on 5/05). Max drawdown unknown but could exceed $200 if string of losing trades. Blow-up scenario: persistent VWAP mean-reversion regimes where reclaim/rejection signals fail, causing repeated stops.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days % of wide_pnl.
